subject: Unexpected token charges after trial credits - immediate assistance requested
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@andreax.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected token charges after trial credits - please advise

Hi Karthik,

We signed up last week and were shown the 30k trial credits in the console. Yesterday we also accepted the 14-day trial extension your onboarding flow offered. However, our August 14 invoice shows a charge for ~12,400 tokens ($72.40). We were expecting the trial credits to apply first and show zero due.

I've attached the invoice (Andreax_invoice_20270814.pdf). Can you explain why we were billed and correct it if this is an error? Also seeing a VAT line on the invoice we weren't expecting — Andreax is VAT-exempt in the US.

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Head of Data Products | Andreax Labs
billing@andreax.io
(415) 555-0118

Attachment: Andreax_invoice_20270814.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@andreax.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15T09:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected token charges after trial credits - please advise

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice. I'm sorry for the confusion.

A few quick asks so we can resolve this ASAP:
- Can you confirm the Customer ID / account email you used to sign in? (I see a few similar emails)
- Do you have a HubSpot/PO or contract reference (if so, please paste the ID) — helps speed finance reconciliation.

I'll loop in our finance lead to review the invoice and confirm whether the trial credits were consumed or if the charge is an error. If it is a mistake we'll issue a credit and updated invoice within one business day.

I understand the VAT concern — if Andreax is US VAT-exempt we should remove that line.

I'll follow up shortly.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
(650) 555-0248

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected token charges — Invoice analysis (internal)

Karthik / Marissa — I pulled the invoice and internal usage logs. Quick notes: 

- Account (Andreax Labs) did start on 2027-08-08 and received the platform self-serve 30k credits automatically.
- Usage timestamps show a spike between 2027-08-13 22:30 UTC and 2027-08-14 01:05 UTC. That consumed ~12.4k tokens after credits were applied — however, the billing run appears to have executed before the credits reconciliation completed due to a timing race between the trial-extension webhook and the daily billing snapshot.
- VAT line is being added because the billing address on file has a VAT field populated; we need confirmation of US exemption for the billing contact to remove VAT going forward.

Recommendation: issue full credit for the token charge and publish a corrected invoice (credit_memo_20270815.pdf). Also add an internal flag to prevent double-billing when a trial-extension event and billing snapshot co-occur. I've attached a draft credit memo for review (credit_memo_draft.pdf).

I'll prepare the credit and the corrected invoice once Karhtik confirms with the customer on the VAT status. Timeline: credit + corrected invoice within 24 hours of confirmation.

Lauren Bishop
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: credit_memo_draft.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@andreax.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15T11:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected token charges after trial credits - proposed remediation

Hi Alex — quick update and proposed plan: 

1) Root cause: internal timing issue — trial-extension webhook and daily billing snapshot overlapped. Our finance team confirms the invoice line should not have billed tokens you had in trial credits.

2) VAT: please confirm whether Andreax Labs is US VAT-exempt and whether the billing contact (billing@andreax.io) can share an exemption certificate. If you prefer, we can remove the VAT line retroactively once you confirm.

3) Remediation: we will issue a credit for the token charge and publish an updated invoice by end of day tomorrow. Credit memo and corrected invoice will be attached; the credit will be applied to your account (visible in the console billing history).

4) Preventive action: engineering will add a reconciliation gate so trial/credit issuance webhooks complete before billing snapshots run (we've prioritized this as S2).

If you authorize us to proceed with the credit and VAT removal (upon confirmation), I'll route the credit now. Reply with "Please proceed" or "Need more info" and we'll act accordingly.

Thanks for raising this — very sorry for the extra noise during onboarding.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
(650) 555-0248
